policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV renders the lemma as 'staff' in 'the staff of his spear,' distinguishing the base qere וְעֵץ; the mapped note is classed alternative_rendering and therefore does not decide the textual reading.
ASV renders the lemma as 'out of the ranks of the Philistines,' distinguishing the base qere מִמַּעַרְכ֣וֹת from the ketiv reading.
